newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil net dollar inflows $479.5 mln July 25.
newsitem.headline: Brazil net dollar inflows $479.5 mln July 25.

text.p: Preliminary figures for Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a $479.5 million surplus on July 25 in the commercial forex market, according to Central Bank.
Dealers said that the large surplus was due to strong financial buys, which totaled $934.7 million.

They said financial buys rose this month partly due to a late June decision by the National Monetary Council (CMN) to allow banks to invest money raised abroad for loans in dollar-indexed National Treasury Notes (NTN-D) prior to lending the money to firms.
